description.text:
The first set of the Diamond & Pearl series and the first with the fourth generation of Pokémon, from the Nintendo DS games, released in May 2007 with 130 cards and three theme decks, Inferno Zone, Royal Frost and Terra Firma. Three of its holos came out a few weeks earlier in tins.

It changed a good deal of the game. Pokémon LV.X replaced Pokémon-ex and Pokémon Star: a LV.X card is played on top of the Pokémon it levels up and keeps that Pokémon's attacks, which brought Levels back onto the cards. Weakness and Resistance now print their amount, some attacks cost no Energy, and Darkness and Metal got basic Energy cards. Poison Pokémon became Psychic instead of Grass, the cards took a new design with larger artwork, and the player who goes first now draws a card but can play no Trainer, Supporter or Stadium that turn.
